workflow.name: BC-03 | Belghamdi Client Onboarding
workflow.description: Event-driven onboarding pipeline: verified order events create clients and send a secure 5-day Telegram form link, with daily reminder/escalation sweeps and a GET/POST form flow (Supabase RPC + Telegram).

nodes.name: orderIntake
nodes.notes: POST verified order events here. Body: order_ref, package_id, duration_days, customer_name, telegram ids, email/phone, kind (renewal|cancel), subscription_code

nodes.name: Register Verified Order

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ p_evt: { event_type: $json.event_type, provider: $json.provider, order_ref: $json.order_ref, package_id: $json.package_id, duration_days: $json.duration_days, customer_name: $json.customer_name, telegram_user_id: $json.telegram_user_id, telegram_chat_id: $json.telegram_chat_id, email: $json.email, phone: $json.phone, kind: $json.kind, subscription_code: $json.subscription_code } }) }}

nodes.notes: Idempotent: dedupes (event_type/provider/order_ref), upserts client + subscription, opens onboarding form request.

parameters.jsCode: return [{ json: { status: 'failed', reason: 'order event registration failed' } }];

nodes.name: Send Onboarding Invite

parameters.text: ={{ 'أهلاً تم تأكيد اشتراكك مع Belghamdi Coaching. خطوة أخيرة: استمارة التسجيل (5 دقائق): ' + $json.link }}

nodes.notes: Client DM with the 5-day secure form link.

nodes.name: Prepare New Client Reply

parameters.jsCode:
const r = $('Register Verified Order').first().json;
return [{ json: { status: 'processed', duplicate: false, client_code: r.client_code, onboarding: 'invite_sent' } }];

nodes.notes: Prepare New Client Reply - Code node

parameters.jsCode:
const r = $('Register Verified Order').first().json;
return [{ json: { status: 'processed', duplicate: false, client_code: r.client_code, onboarding: 'invite_stored_no_telegram' } }];

parameters.text: ={{ ($json.reminder_no === 2 ? 'مهم: ' : 'تذكير لطيف: ') + 'استمارة التسجيل لعميل ' + ($json.client_code || '') + ' ناقصة. أكملها من هنا: ' + $json.link }}
={{ 'استمارة تسجيل ' + $json.client_code + ' لم تُكمل بعد 72 ساعة. تم إنشاء مهمة مراجعة.' }}
